instructions: K5 retains Natural Earth Perlis, Labuan and North Borneo. Limbang belongs to Sarawak after 1890; the excluded Lawas piece belongs to Brunei in 1896. In K6, after the 1905 acquisition, restore full Sarawak.
K5 regional labels must retain certainty approximate and identify the 1898 map comparison used for the 1896 frame. G23 has 1.80 km fit RMS and 2.45 km LOO RMS.
Use G21/G23 for peninsular units; G23 and Natural Earth land for Dindings; G21/G34 for Sarawak; G21/G22/G34 for Brunei.
Append Dindings as a Straits Settlements feature in K5, K6 and K6a. FMS outputs already subtract Dindings; K6b restores full modern Perak because the cession was in 1935.

FMS source tracing covers northern Perak, western Kelantan, northern Pahang and Terengganu, and Johor north. Kelantan is now traced around its complete external frontier, including the portion now inside Thailand and its ridge against Terengganu. Siam excludes that historic Kelantan territory.
Internal boundaries among the four FMS states do not render because their union is one holder. Remaining Natural Earth edges retain their existing approximation.
The Sembilan islands below the shared Natural Earth 10m resolution are not invented; a precise historic delta half-island boundary cannot be recovered at this display scale.
status: Reconstruction complete with declared regional approximate geometry; not survey accuracy.
